title: From Hackathon to Ecosystem
body: From a 2021 Meta hackathon to an industry ecosystem. We deliver real responsibilities, skills, and elite networking.

title: Key Metrics & Impact
body: 800+ hackathon students. 10k+ SOARX members. 100+ students hosted at Microsoft. 20+ Shark Tank founders connected.

title: Industry Collaborations
body: Partnering with Meta, Snap AR, UiPath, and Microsoft to bridge campus talent with top-tier industry insights.

title: Seekers of Contributors
body: For 1st-Year CSE/IT/BCA students. 10 spots only. Bring skills, eagerness to learn, and a drive to take ownership.
